repository.name: @webex/webex-core
repository.purpose: Core library of the Cisco Webex JS SDK: the plugin host and WebexCore class, the HTTP interceptor pipeline, OAuth credentials and token lifecycle, U2C service discovery (v1 and opt-in v2), and the pluggable storage layer that every other SDK plugin builds on.

public_interfaces.name: package exports
public_interfaces.audience: About 47 workspace packages inside the Webex JS SDK plus external npm consumers of @webex/webex-core.
public_interfaces.notes: Verify names against src/index.js and the compatibility commitments against the Public surface sections of the module specifications.

public_interfaces.name: package scripts
public_interfaces.audience: Contributors and CI jobs operating on this package from the workspace root.
public_interfaces.notes: The aggregate test script chains lint, unit, integration and browser tiers and needs provisioned test users and live services.

evidence_rules.requirement: Emit a command only when its script exists in package.json and uses the workspace-scoped invocation.
evidence_rules.notes: The aggregate test script needs live services and test users; do not present it as a quick check.

evidence_rules.requirement: Emit an export name only when it is re-exported by src/index.js and reachable through the entry point declared by main or devMain.
Ground every behavior claim in the implementation and state separately whether a test observes it.
evidence_rules.notes: Commit history is not acceptable rationale evidence for this package.

evidence_rules.requirement: Never ship a template placeholder in a generated document; replace it with verified repository evidence or surface the gap as a blocking question.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not reorder the imports in src/index.js.
negative_guidance.why: Services and credentials must initialize inside core before consumer plugins register.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not treat the README storage example as current.
negative_guidance.why: It documents storage.adapter and webex.storage, which the code does not implement; the code uses boundedAdapter/unboundedAdapter.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not assume services-v2 is active.
negative_guidance.why: It is exported but registered only when a host calls registerInternalPlugin with replace.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not log or persist tokens in new ways.
negative_guidance.why: Tokens are already persisted as plaintext JSON; every additional sink widens exposure.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not cite commit or pull-request history as rationale for current behavior.
negative_guidance.why: The owner directed that onboarding evidence come from the working tree only.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not publish a Repo Standards template out of .sdd/templates into docs.
negative_guidance.why: Authoring templates stay hidden; only instantiated, repository-grounded documents belong in the visible documentation tree.

high.expectation: The claim is backed by source and tests and the affected specification sections are updated in the same change.

medium.expectation: Implementation evidence exists but no test observes the behavior. Record the gap in the Verification section rather than asserting verified coverage.

low.expectation: Neither code nor tests establish the fact. Stop and ask the package owner; do not fall back to commit history or a plausible default.

main_entrypoints.name: package entry point
main_entrypoints.purpose: Barrel declaring the entire public surface and loading the core plugins in a fixed order.
main_entrypoints.notes: Workspace consumers resolve it through devMain; published consumers resolve dist through main.

workspace_packages.notes: One published library package inside the Webex JS SDK yarn workspace.

surface_owners.edit_boundary: A change to an exported surface must update the owning module specification in the same commit.

surface_owners.surface: release, changelog, contribution policy, and security policy
surface_owners.edit_boundary: Not owned by this package. It intentionally ships no CHANGELOG.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, or SECURITY.md.

fallback_rules: When code and this context disagree, the code wins; correct the context and the affected specification sections in the same change.
When a fact cannot be established from source, tests or package.json, stop and ask the package owner rather than inferring it from commit history.
When a required command is missing, say so and stop; do not substitute a plausible alternative.
When a change would alter the published export surface, treat it as breaking until a dependent-package review proves otherwise.
